funding.supported_assets_note: Argentina help article: the card 'solo va a funcionar si tiene fondos en pesos argentinos o en crypto' (prepaid, single instalment). Cashback page: paying 'en dólares digitales u otro activo' carries 'una comisión del 0,5% en el momento de pago'. Colombia post: balance deposited in pesos by PSE from any bank or wallet; ACH in/out, Bre-B integration under way. Which assets other than 'dólares digitales' can be spent is not listed on the pages read.

eligibility.nationality_restrictions_note: Help article: 'Ser mayor de 18 años', 'Tener un documento de identidad argentino', 'Tener una cuenta creada y validada en Lemon'. The requirement is an Argentine identity document rather than a residence statement.
eligibility.usage_note: Usable 'en cualquier comercio o página web del mundo que esté dentro de la red VISA' and 'en cualquier país del mundo' after a travel form (no confirmation needed). Lemon also runs the card in Colombia (own variant below) and publishes separate help centres and terms for Perú, Brasil and Chile; those markets are not modelled because no official card page for them could be read this run (Peru limits article and Colombia card collection returned a client error).

kyc.thresholds_note: No threshold or limit tied to verification level is published on the pages read; the purchase-limit help articles returned a client error. The only limit figure read: spending abroad 'serán deducidos de tu límite de compra de los USD 200 (dólar ahorro) de los meses siguientes' (a tax/FX-regime limit, not a card limit).
kyc.stages_note: A 'cuenta creada y validada en Lemon' and an Argentine identity document are required before requesting the card (help article). The validation procedure itself is not described on the pages read.

access.note: 'La tarjeta no tiene costos de envío ni de mantenimiento' (help article); 'Nuestra tarjeta internacional gratuita' (Colombia post, for Colombia).

fees.conditions: The Argentina help article names only delivery and maintenance as free; no issuance figure for the virtual or physical card appears on the Argentina pages read (the Colombia post states free issuance for Colombia only). The card T&C (digifin.ghost.io) could not be read.
'La tarjeta no tiene costos de envío ni de mantenimiento' (help article 'Qué es la Lemon Card').
Funding is the Lemon account balance in pesos or crypto; no deposit/top-up fee statement on the pages read.

Cashback page, section on paying 'en dólares digitales u otro activo' with Lemon Card or QR: '*Hay una comisión del 0,5% en el momento de pago.*' No fee is stated for payments debited from the peso balance.

The product page only states that foreign-currency purchases do not pay the 30% 'impuesto RG5617' perception ('Chau percepción del 30%', 'Un dólar es un dólar') — a tax statement, not a Lemon fee. The help article '¿Qué pasa cuándo hago consumos en moneda extranjera?' returned a client error; exchange rate, spread or fee not established.
ATM withdrawals are not mentioned; the product page offers cash withdrawal 'en comercios adheridos' (map of merchants) without a fee statement.

rewards.conditions: 'Hasta 1% de cashback pagando en pesos' — 'Todas las compras que hagas en pesos con Lemon Card o QR en Argentina generan hasta un 1% de cashback en Bitcoin o dólares digitales'; 'automático y aplica en cualquier comercio físico o virtual del país'. What determines the rate below the 1% ceiling, the monthly cap, instant credit and foreign-currency purchases are FAQ headings whose answers are not rendered on the page.
rewards.description: Up to 1% back in Bitcoin or digital dollars on purchases paid in Argentine pesos (Argentina only per the page).

editorial.summary: Prepaid Visa card of the Argentine crypto app Lemon (Bay Treasure Caramel S.A., registered VASP; payment account by Digifin S.A.), virtual or physical, with no delivery or maintenance fee, spending from a pesos or crypto balance. In Argentina it pays up to 1% cashback in Bitcoin or digital dollars on purchases in pesos and up to 2% when paying from digital dollars or another crypto asset (a 0.5% commission applies at payment); foreign-currency purchases are advertised as exempt from the 30% tax perception. A Colombian version launched in May 2026 with free issuance and maintenance and 0.4% cashback in digital dollars. The card issuer, the card terms, FX and ATM fees, limits and cashback caps could not be read this run (terms hosted on a third-party domain, help-centre articles returning errors).

A 0.5% commission applies when paying from digital dollars or another crypto asset.
Foreign-currency purchases: the 30% perception exemption is a tax statement; Lemon's own FX rate/fee is unknown.
Argentina: an Argentine identity document and a validated Lemon account are required; spending abroad counts against a USD 200 'dólar ahorro' limit per the help article.
Colombia: physical card was on a waitlist at launch (May 2026); KYC stage not read.
Lemon also sells a Bitcoin-backed Visa credit card in Argentina (not modelled here; separate product).
